# Controlled Documentation Requirements Checklist: Controlled Product Documentation

**Purpose**: Reviewer-owned requirements-quality review for the eight core product-definition documents, their supporting record classes, and the evidence/gate controls that make the baseline usable before production implementation.
**Created**: 2026-08-28
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: The 52-item list below is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review
artifact. In that controlled checklist, mark an item `[x]` only when the attributable reviewer
determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` in the controlled checklist means the criterion has been reviewed and
satisfied for requirements quality. It does not by itself establish independent specialist review,
material-gate approval or implementation authorization.

## Reviewer Disposition

| Field | Recorded value |
|---|---|
| Review date | 2026-08-28 |
| Reviewer identity | Product Decision Authority organizational role (the Principal Product Author's manager); review confirmed on 2026-08-28 |
| Attribution status | `RECORDED` for the Product Decision Authority organizational role; independent specialist/material-gate attribution remains `BLOCKED` |
| Decision source | The Product Decision Authority reviewed the written requirements and confirmed all 52 criteria as satisfied on 2026-08-28 |
| Competence basis | Organizational authority for product specification, feature scope, and technology decisions |
| Author/owner separation | The reviewer is organizationally separate from the Principal Product Author; because the reviewer owns material product decisions, this record does not establish independent specialist or material-gate review |
| Specialist coverage | `Specialist Review Gap` remains for any criterion requiring specialist ISO/IEC, HCD/accessibility, security/privacy, verification, or other domain competence |
| Disposition | `52/52` controlled criteria are reviewed and satisfied by the Product Decision Authority role; independent specialist/material-gate acceptance remains `BLOCKED` |
| Boundary | This disposition closes the T053/T060 requirements-quality checklist only; it does not approve PG2/PG3/PG5/PG6, establish standards conformity, execute the retained Validation Pack, or authorize production implementation |

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - [Completeness] [Spec §Requirements—FR-001/FR-002] Does the specification name exactly the eight core classes DOC-01 through DOC-08, distinguish a document class from its instances, and assign each class a purpose and authority boundary?
- [x] CHK002 - [Completeness] [Spec §Requirements—FR-003] Are all nine supporting record classes (GOV, CLR, RSK, VVP, VEV, CMP, CHG, REL, OPS) named with their distinct purpose and relationship to the core set?
- [x] CHK003 - [Completeness] [Spec §Requirements—FR-006/FR-007] Does the common control contract enumerate every required identity, ownership, lifecycle, version, approval, and change field rather than relying on an implied template convention?
- [x] CHK004 - [Completeness] [Spec §Requirements—FR-013–FR-023] Does each of DOC-01 through DOC-08 have an explicit content contract, including its required decisions, evidence, boundaries, and links to adjacent documents?
- [x] CHK005 - [Completeness] [Spec §Requirements—FR-024–FR-032] Are evidence classes, bidirectional traceability, gate inputs/outcomes, action records, independent review, and the implementation-authorization boundary all represented as requirements?
- [x] CHK006 - [Completeness] [Spec §Requirements—FR-040–FR-043] Are the internal-company boundary, MVP Release Spine, Generic Controlled-File Baseline, and extensible deep-format profile represented without implying a commercial product commitment?

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 - [Clarity] [Spec §Key Entities—Core Product Document/Supporting Record] Are stable document IDs, class codes, titles, repository paths, and instance identity defined in terms that cannot be confused with one another?
- [x] CHK008 - [Clarity] [Spec §Requirements—FR-007; §User Stories & Testing—User Story 2] Are document statuses (Draft, Proposed, Approved, Superseded, Retired), `Start`/`In Work` work states, and gate outcomes (PASS, PASS-WITH-ACTIONS, FAIL, BLOCKED) explicitly separate vocabularies?
- [x] CHK009 - [Clarity] [Spec §Requirements—FR-006/FR-012; §Key Entities—Product Generation/Business Revision] Do the requirements clearly distinguish document Version (`major.minor`), Product Generation, Business Revision, Git commit, and rendition source identity?
- [x] CHK010 - [Clarity] [Spec §Requirements—FR-024–FR-026] Can a reader tell the difference between evidence class, claim status, disposition, assumption, `UNKNOWN`, and `BLOCKED`, including who may resolve each state?
- [x] CHK011 - [Clarity] [Spec §Requirements—FR-021–FR-023] Are the cross-surface HCD/accessibility profiles and the conditional applicability of WCAG, WAI-ARIA, and EN 301 549 stated in language that does not overclaim conformity?

- [x] CHK013 - [Consistency] [Spec §Requirements—FR-002/FR-005/FR-026/FR-027] Do the catalogue, navigation entry point, authority boundaries, and traceability views consistently preserve one authoritative source per requirement and avoid a competing second baseline?
- [x] CHK014 - [Consistency] [Spec §Requirements—FR-031/FR-038/FR-039; §User Stories & Testing—User Story 2/6] Are Technical Pilot Verification, Internal Pilot Acceptance, representative acceptance, and single-actor multi-identity operation kept distinct throughout the specification?
- [x] CHK015 - [Consistency] [Spec §Requirements—FR-029–FR-032; §Key Entities—Gate Decision] Do PG0–PG7 retain one consistent meaning, input set, outcome vocabulary, action rule, and production-authorization rule across the spec and plan?
- [x] CHK016 - [Consistency] [Spec §Requirements—FR-011/FR-012; §Plan §Technical Context] Is Markdown consistently the authoritative editable source while DOCX/PDF remain identifiable renditions, with material changes linked to CHG or a traceable Work Item?

## Notes

- This checklist is intentionally separate from the built-in `checklists/requirements.md`, which is maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
- Items are intentionally unchecked on generation. In this retained record, all 52 controlled criteria
  are `[x]` because the Product Decision Authority reviewed the written requirements and confirmed them
  as satisfied on 2026-08-28. This requirements-quality review does not establish independent specialist
  review or gate approval. Future checklist instances should be marked only after the responsible
  reviewer evaluates the written requirements and records attributable identity and competence.
- Recommended timing: review before `$speckit-tasks`, and repeat at the relevant pull-request or gate review when the spec, plan, or supporting records materially change.
- Findings should be recorded inline or linked to a `CHG`, `CLR`, `RSK`, or traceable Work Item; checklist state is not an implementation-status claim.
